footer.tagline: Your trusted cab partner in Tirupati for temple tours, outstation travel and airport transfers.
footer.pricingNote: Prices include driver allowance. Tolls, parking and state permits charged separately. Extra km charges apply beyond the included allowance.

services.sectionSubtitle: From local temple visits to long-distance South India pilgrimages — we cover every journey.

localCab.title: Tirupati Local Cab Services
localCab.description: Comfortable and reliable local cab services for temple visits, hospital trips, city sightseeing, hotel transfers and local errands within Tirupati. Available 24/7.

tiramalaTaxi.title: Tirupati to Tirumala Taxi
tiramalaTaxi.description: Dedicated taxi service to Tirumala by experienced local drivers familiar with the ghat road. Safe, comfortable and available at any hour for your darshan.

templeTours.title: Temple Tour Packages
templeTours.description: Planned pilgrimage tour packages covering sacred temples in and around Tirupati and across South India — from city darshans to multi-day inter-state journeys.

outstationCab.title: Outstation Cab Services
outstationCab.description: Comfortable cab hire for outstation travel across Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Telangana and Karnataka. One-way and round-trip options available.

airportTransfer.title: Airport Pickup & Drop
airportTransfer.description: Punctual pickup and drop at Tirupati Airport, Renigunta Airport and nearby airports. Tracked flight times — no extra wait charges for delayed arrivals.

railwayTransfer.title: Railway Station Transfers
railwayTransfer.description: Smooth transfers to and from Tirupati Railway Station and Renigunta Junction. Early morning and late night arrivals handled without any extra charges.

tempoTraveller.title: Tempo Traveller Rental
tempoTraveller.description: Spacious Tempo Traveller (12+1) and Force Urbania (12 Seater) for group pilgrimages, family gatherings and corporate outings. Driver included; custom routes accommodated.

southIndiaTours.title: South India Pilgrimage Tours
southIndiaTours.description: Carefully planned multi-day pilgrimage tours to major South India temples — Tirupati, Kalahasti, Kanipakam, Madurai, Rameswaram, Kanchipuram and more.

customTours.title: Custom & Corporate Tours
customTours.description: Tailored travel plans for corporate outings, family events, wedding convoys and special group requirements. Contact us with your itinerary for a custom quote.
